installation_summary:
Installed SVA Studio (pnpm/Nx monorepo) in /workspace at commit 6394d99 on Ubuntu 22.04.

Toolchain: No Node.js/pnpm was preinstalled. Installed Node.js v24.15.0 from the official nodejs.org linux-x64 tarball into /usr/local (matches .nvmrc, .node-version and package.json engines). Enabled Corepack and activated pnpm@11.3.0 (matches packageManager). Both persisted at /usr/local/bin/node and /usr/local/bin/pnpm.

Dependencies: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` succeeded for all 37 workspace projects (exit 0), honoring pnpm-workspace.yaml (apps/*, packages/*, tooling/*).

Verification (guide's canonical gates):
1. `pnpm check:toolchain-consistency` -> "Toolchain-Konsistenzpruefung erfolgreich", exit 0 (Node v24.15.0, pnpm 11.3.0, vite/vitest/nx/tanstack/nitro match pnpm-lock.yaml).
2. `pnpm nx run sva-studio-react:verify:runtime-artifact --skip-nx-cache` -> exit 0 after ~2m48s. This self-contained target (scripts/ci/verify-runtime-artifact.sh) builds the full workspace, creates ephemeral Postgres (16-alpine) + Redis (7-alpine) + an in-process mock Keycloak, applies IAM goose migrations, syncs injected workspace packages, then boots the final production Node output `apps/sva-studio-react/.output/server/index.mjs` and probes endpoints with HTTP assertions. Generated report artifacts/runtime/runtime-artifact-verify/runtime-artifact-verify-1791148450.json has status "ok", failureClass "none", and all phases ok: postgres-ready, postgres-app-role, schema-migrations, redis-ready, keycloak-ready, artifact-contract, injected-workspace-sync, app-start, health-live, health-ready, root-page. `/health/live` -> {"status":"alive"}, `/health/ready` -> {"status":"ready"} (db/redis/keycloak=true), `/` -> HTTP 200.

Abandoned/blocked attempt: the guide's primary local runtime path `pnpm env:up:local-keycloak` aborts at config load with ENOENT on /workspace/config/runtime/base.vars. Both config/runtime/base.vars and config/runtime/local-keycloak.vars are listed in .gitignore (lines 85, 87), are absent from the checkout, and no template/generator exists in the repo (only *.vars.example files such as studio/staging/dev exist). These files hold site-specific and secret values, so they cannot be fabricated from the repository. This is a documentation/configuration gap rather than a code defect; the guide documents multiple paths and the canonical build/runtime verification path succeeded and was used as the installation proof.

Final state: git working tree clean (only ignored artifacts: node_modules, apps/sva-studio-react/.output, artifacts/). Runtime entrypoints: dev server `pnpm nx run sva-studio-react:serve` (port 3000); built app `node apps/sva-studio-react/.output/server/index.mjs`. To enable the profile commands, create config/runtime/base.vars and config/runtime/local-keycloak.vars (or *.local.vars) locally.
additional_actions: Installed Node.js v24.15.0 from the official nodejs.org distribution because no Node toolchain was preinstalled (the guide assumes Node is available).
Enabled Corepack and activated pnpm@11.3.0 (the guide shows corepack as one option; performed non-interactively).

Ran the canonical self-contained build/runtime verification target `pnpm nx run sva-studio-react:verify:runtime-artifact --skip-nx-cache` to obtain objective installation evidence, since the primary env:up path requires uncommitted local config.
verification: Verification method: (a) `pnpm check:toolchain-consistency` and (b) the guide's canonical build/runtime proof `pnpm nx run sva-studio-react:verify:runtime-artifact --skip-nx-cache`. Both exited 0. The verify target booted the built production Node output against ephemeral Postgres/Redis/mock-Keycloak and asserted HTTP responses. Observed result: report artifacts/runtime/runtime-artifact-verify/runtime-artifact-verify-1791148450.json status=ok, failureClass=none, all 11 phases ok; /health/live 200 {"status":"alive"}, /health/ready 200 {"status":"ready", db/redis/keycloak true}, / 200. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` also exited 0.
